ambient_events: The chiller cabinet cycles up, runs a while, and settles again.
Water ticks into a drain somewhere behind the wall.
The building holds its cool while the street outside goes on baking.
A fly finds the room, decides against it, and leaves.
The curtain in the corner moves a little on nothing you can feel.
Somewhere out back, metal is being struck once, and then once more, unhurried.
description: Cool, dim, and startlingly clean, which is the first thing that gets you. A chiller cabinet takes up the back wall, running off the town's grid and running well. A workbench along one side holds a jar of nails, a hammer, and a punch, and beside them a stack of pipe offcuts cut to a length that means only one thing. Somebody has hung a curtain to make a corner private. It is the only soft thing in the building.
name: The Cold Room
